notes.title: 【November 16, 2021】we have updated the English language version

notes.title: 《Physics world》has already published on Nov.15,2021
notes.notes:
Physics world has already released the EA version on November 15, 2021! Price is 3.99$，10% off for first week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40488176/cc1dbd078e4b997496c5326eb20ba7657df466ba.jpg[/img]

We add the BGM to our game in Sep，complete  our workshop in Oct and add players works to it.We finally decide to publish our game in November 15th.

After EA released, we will continue to improve our game to bring a better user experience for all our game players.
